# Overview

**Module 7: Repeat lengths**

Every repeat-length distribution in one place:

1. **Cohort heatmaps** – every sample's distribution side by side, one per measure, grouped by settings group and ordered by time
2. **Ridge plots by group** – each group's samples stacked in time order
3. **Sample cards** – one figure per sample with a histogram of every measure, the analysis ranges shaded, the modal, median and mean of the plotted ranges marked, and (with UMIs) the molecule distribution overlaid

Reads are grey and molecules teal throughout.

**Outputs:**

- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/heatmap_{measure}.png`, `ridges/`, `sample_cards/{sample}.png`
- `07_repeat_lengths/repeat_lengths.xlsx` – the sample order and labels used

```{r load}
safe_load_module(file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "03_repeat_detection.RData"), 3)
measures <- module3_output$measures; primary <- module3_output$primary
lengths <- module3_output$lengths
mol <- NULL
m4 <- file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "04_umi.RData")
if (isTRUE(params$umi) && file.exists(m4)) { safe_load_module(m4, 4); mol <- module4_output$molecule_lengths }
m6 <- file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "06_instability.RData")
have_m6 <- file.exists(m6)
if (have_m6) { safe_load_module(m6, 6); settings <- module6_output$settings; range_table <- as.data.table(module6_output$range_table)
               dist <- module6_output$distribution_summary } else { settings <- NULL; range_table <- NULL; dist <- NULL }
samples <- unique(lengths$file_stem)
meta <- data.table(file_stem = samples)
if (!is.null(settings)) meta <- as.data.table(settings)[, .(file_stem, group, time)][meta, on = "file_stem"] else meta[, `:=`(group = NA_character_, time = NA_real_)]
meta[, group_label := ifelse(is.na(group), "ungrouped", group)]
setorder(meta, group_label, time, file_stem, na.last = TRUE)
meta[, sample_label := make.unique(ifelse(is.na(time), file_stem, paste0(file_stem, " (t=", time, ")")))]
meta[, sample_label := factor(sample_label, levels = sample_label)]
meta[, sample_index := seq_len(.N)]
# Sample labels: the part of the file name that differs between samples (e.g. kxF01--kxR13) when
# that is short, otherwise the sample's index in this report (mapped to its file in repeat_lengths.xlsx)
sl <- short_labels(meta$file_stem)[meta$file_stem]
base_lab <- if (max(nchar(sl)) <= 20) sl else as.character(meta$sample_index)
meta[, short_label := make.unique(ifelse(is.na(time), base_lab, paste0(base_lab, " (t=", time, ")")))]
meta[, short_label := factor(short_label, levels = short_label)]
plot_ranges <- if (length(params$plot_ranges)) params$plot_ranges else if (have_m6) head(sort(unique(range_table$range_name[range_table$measure == primary])), 2) else character(0)
acc_path <- file.path(params$dir_out, "02_alignment", "alignment.xlsx")
funnel <- if (file.exists(acc_path)) as.data.table(readxl::read_excel(acc_path, "read_accounting")) else NULL
```

`r if (!have_m6) "Module 6 has not been run (no settings file), so samples are not grouped and no ranges are drawn." else ""`

---

# Cohort heatmaps

Each column is one sample and each row one repeat length; the colour is the share of that sample's reads (or molecules) at that length, on a log scale from 0.01%, so a minor allele and a thin expansion tail are as visible as the main peak; white means no reads. The rarest 0.1% of lengths at the top are not drawn, so the alleles fill the plot. Panels are settings groups, and samples within a group are in time order, labelled by the part of the file name that differs between samples (or by an index, mapped to files in `repeat_lengths.xlsx`) and time. A stable sample is a narrow band; somatic expansion shows as the band spreading upward over time.

```{r heatmaps, results='asis', fig.height=7}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
hm_w <- min(45, max(9, 3 + 0.15 * length(samples)))
for (u in c("reads", if (!is.null(mol)) "molecules")) for (m in measures$measure) {
  src <- if (u == "reads") lengths[measure == m, .(file_stem, length)] else mol[measure == m, .(file_stem, length)]
  if (!nrow(src)) next
  d <- meta[, .(file_stem, sample_label = short_label, group_label)][src, on = "file_stem"]
  p <- length_heatmap(d, sprintf("%s length, %s", m, u), params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, paste(m, "length"))
  save_plot(p, file.path(plots_dir, sprintf("heatmap_%s_%s.png", safe_path(m), u)), hm_w, 7)
  if (u == "reads" || m == primary) { cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s, %s\n\n", m, u)); print(p) }
}
timings["Heatmaps"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```

---

# Ridge plots by group

Each ridge is one sample's `r primary` distribution (reads), scaled to its own height, with samples in time order from top to bottom; one figure per group. The left panel shows all reads, where the largest allele sets the height; the other panels show only the reads in each plotted range (`r paste(plot_ranges, collapse = ", ")`), so the shape of a smaller allele is visible. The x-axis stops at the cohort's 99.9th percentile. Up to four groups are shown here; every group is in `plots/ridges/`.

```{r ridges, results='asis', fig.height=6}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
d <- meta[, .(file_stem, short_label, group_label)][lengths[measure == primary, .(file_stem, length)], on = "file_stem"]
xcap <- stats::quantile(d$length, 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
d <- d[length <= xcap]
d_all <- d[, panel := "All reads"]
# Reads within each plotted range of the primary measure, per sample
if (have_m6 && length(plot_ranges)) {
  rb <- range_table[measure == primary & range_name %in% plot_ranges, .(file_stem, range_name, range_text, lo, hi)]
  d_rng <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(unique(rb[, .(range_name, range_text)]))), function(k) {
    rk <- unique(rb[, .(range_name, range_text)])[k]
    b <- rb[range_name == rk$range_name]
    x <- b[d[, .(file_stem, short_label, group_label, length)], on = "file_stem", nomatch = NULL][length >= lo & length <= hi]
    x[, .(file_stem, short_label, group_label, length, panel = paste0(rk$range_name, " (", rk$range_text, ")"))]
  }))
  d <- rbind(d_all, d_rng)
}
d[, panel := factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))]
shown <- 0
for (g in unique(meta$group_label)) {
  dg <- d[group_label == g]
  if (!nrow(dg)) next
  n_s <- uniqueN(dg$file_stem); h <- min(40, 2 + 0.45 * n_s)
  dg[, short_label := factor(short_label, levels = rev(levels(meta$short_label)))]
  p <- ggplot(dg, aes(length, short_label)) +
    geom_density_ridges(fill = "grey70", colour = "grey20", scale = 1.6, rel_min_height = 0.005, bandwidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(8)) +
    labs(x = paste(primary, "length"), y = NULL, title = paste("Repeat length by sample:", g)) + theme_bw()
  save_plot(p, file.path(plots_dir, "ridges", paste0(safe_path(g), ".png")), min(45, 5 + 4 * nlevels(d$panel)), h)
  if (shown < 4) { cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", g)); print(p); shown <- shown + 1 }
}
timings["Ridges"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```

---

# Sample cards

One figure per sample, one row per measure. The first panel shows all reads on a square-root scale, so a small expanded allele stays visible beside a large normal one; the next panels zoom into ranges `r paste(plot_ranges, collapse = ", ")` with the range's modal (red), median (purple) and mean (orange) marked`r if (!is.null(mol)) ". Molecules are the teal line, scaled to the same total as the reads" else ""`. The subtitle gives the sample's read accounting. One card from each of up to four groups is shown; every card is in `plots/sample_cards/`.

```{r sample_cards, eval=params$sample_cards, results='asis', fig.height=4.5, fig.width=13.5}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
card_dir <- file.path(plots_dir, "sample_cards")
show_s <- meta[, .SD[1], by = group_label][1:min(.N, 4), file_stem]
for (s in meta$file_stem) {
  panels <- list()
  for (m in measures$measure) {
    r <- lengths[file_stem == s & measure == m, length]
    if (!length(r)) next
    mm <- if (!is.null(mol)) mol[file_stem == s & measure == m, length] else NULL
    panels[[length(panels) + 1]] <- length_panel(r, mm, NULL, paste0(m, ": all reads"), paste(m, "length"),
                                                 params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, sqrt_y = TRUE)
    if (have_m6) for (rgn in plot_ranges) {
      rr <- range_table[file_stem == s & measure == m & range_name == rgn][1]
      if (is.na(rr$lo)) next
      sel <- lengths[file_stem == s & measure == rr$range_measure]
      ids <- sel$qname[sel$length >= rr$lo & sel$length <= rr$hi]
      x <- lengths[file_stem == s & measure == m & qname %in% ids, length]
      if (!length(x)) next
      mk <- dist[file_stem == s & measure == m & unit == "reads" & analysis_range_name == rgn, .(modal = modal_length, median = median_length, mean = mean_length)]
      mk <- if (nrow(mk)) melt(mk, measure.vars = c("modal", "median", "mean"), variable.name = "stat") else NULL
      xm <- NULL
      if (!is.null(mol)) {
        ml <- mol[file_stem == s]
        mids <- ml[measure == rr$range_measure & length >= rr$lo & length <= rr$hi, molecule_id]
        xm <- ml[measure == m & molecule_id %in% mids, length]
      }
      panels[[length(panels) + 1]] <- length_panel(x, xm, mk, sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", m, rgn, rr$range_text %||% rr$range_label), paste(m, "length"),
                                                   params$repeat_histogram_binwidth)
    }
  }
  ncol_card <- 1 + length(plot_ranges)
  panels <- Filter(Negate(is.null), panels)
  if (!length(panels)) next
  fn <- if (!is.null(funnel)) funnel[file_stem == s][1] else NULL
  sub <- if (!is.null(fn) && nrow(fn)) sprintf("Reads: %s input, %s spanning both flanks, %s analysed%s", comma(fn$input), comma(fn$both_flanks), comma(fn$final),
                                               if (!is.null(mol)) sprintf("; %s molecules", comma(uniqueN(mol[file_stem == s, molecule_id]))) else "") else NULL
  g <- meta[file_stem == s, group_label]; tm <- meta[file_stem == s, time]
  card <- patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, ncol = ncol_card) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = s, subtitle = paste0(g, if (!is.na(tm)) paste0(", time ", tm) else "", if (!is.null(sub)) paste0("\n", sub) else ""))
  save_plot(card, file.path(card_dir, paste0(s, ".png")), 4.5 * ncol_card, 1.5 + 3.2 * ceiling(length(panels) / ncol_card))
  if (s %in% show_s) { print(card) }
}
timings["Sample cards"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```
